name: WaterBench_Basin
description: WATER v4 bench #1 (docs/WaterRethink.md WP0/WP3). The shallow-water + shoreline rig. NO world block on purpose: a world block regenerates terrain every launch and would refill the carved basin (same rule as DebrisLab). The terrain lives only in worlds/default.db, authored ONCE by `python tools/water_bench.py build-basin` and verified by `python tools/water_bench.py verify basin`. Everything sits inside ONE chunk (x,z 0..31): an 8-thick Stone slab (top solid y=16), basin A with a stepped ~1:3 ramp (west) and a vertical wall (east), a notch+channel north to the DRY sibling basin B (the control). No hydrology bake, no water at boot: the sim prototype places water via the API.

water._comment: Deliberately OFF. Any implicit sea at kSeaLevelY=16 would flood the basin (floor top y=12) before a test starts. The WP3 prototype adds water itself and must find the rig bone dry (verify checks total_mass == 0).

camera._comment: Spawn vantage only. Reproducible poses live in testVantages.

basinA._comment: 4 deep at the flat floor (water cells y 13..16 possible; fill 3 deep = cells 13..15, surface 16.0, one voxel of freeboard). Dam-break run: initial block x 22..28, h0=3, front travels west L=10 u to the ramp foot at x=12 -> Ritter 2*sqrt(9.81*3)=10.8 u/s -> ~0.93 s. Ramp is voxel-stepped ~1:3, NOT the 1:10 of the first draft (a 1:10 ramp 3 deep needs 30 u; the rig must stay inside one chunk).

channel._comment: Spills from basin A into basin B only when A's surface exceeds 15.0 (fill 3 deep spills; fill 2 deep does not) - the falsifiable pair.

basinB._comment: DRY control. Must hold 0 mass unless water crosses the channel.

testVantages._comment: Fixed poses. Changing one silently invalidates every archived capture taken from it. yaw convention: editor camera yaw -90 = -Z, 0 = +X, 90 = +Z.
